label: Review Deck -- every record read, stamped, dealt
description: 'It reads every one': rich record cards dealt one at a time. On each card a highlight scans down, a tick lands on each row it passes, a verdict STAMPS on (Shortlisted / Not this search, or your own words), and the card is dealt away -- kept ones up and out, passed ones down -- as the next rises from the deck behind. A small counter ('Application 127 of 480') ticks per card. Use it for applications, leads, tickets, invoices -- any 'the agent reviews each one' beat. 2-6 cards; about 2-3 s each. Size it with its box; fits 16x9, 9x16, 4x5. Anchors: card, avatar.

cards.label: The records, in deal order: [{name, role, avatar (URL, optional), rows: 2-4 short lines (experience, signals), thumbs: 0-4 image URLs, quote (optional), keep: false for a pass, stamp: custom verdict text}]

counter.label: The ticking counter: {label: 'Application', from: 127, total: 480} (omit for none)

labels.label: Section and stamp words: {rows: 'Experience', thumbs: 'Portfolio', quote: 'Why this role', yes: 'Shortlisted', no: 'Not this search'}

per_card.label: Seconds per card (default: the scene shared out, 1.6-3.2)

at.label: When the first card rises (scene seconds, default 0.3)

color.label: Accent (scan band, stamp dot; default brand primary)
